description: This Python module performs subtitle correction and alignment based on a Whisper-like transcript. It provides functions to normalize text, match subtitle cues to transcript segments, and enforce OTT timing constraints. The core function 'correct_subtitles' aligns and adjusts subtitle cues for improved synchronization, handling text corrections, missing cues, and timing constraints. It is designed to be language-agnostic, with no external dependencies beyond standard library modules.

methods.name: str _normalize_text(text: str)
methods.description: Unicode normalization to NFKC, collapsing whitespace to normalize text for comparison.

methods.name: float _safe_float(x: Any, default: float = 0.0)
methods.description: Safely convert a value to float, returning default on failure.

methods.name: str _ms_to_srt_time(ms: int)
methods.description: Convert milliseconds to SRT timestamp format (HH:MM:SS,mmm).

methods.name: int _s_to_ms(s: float)
methods.description: Convert seconds (float) to milliseconds (int).

methods.name: Optional[str] _normalize_lang_code(value: Optional[str])
methods.description: Normalize language code string to lowercase and trimmed.

methods.name: bool _likely_same_language(transcript: Dict[str, Any], subtitles: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Determine if transcript and subtitles are likely in the same language based on explicit keys and heuristics.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _flatten_transcript_segments(transcript: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Flatten transcript segments into a list with start_ms, end_ms, and normalized text.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _normalize_subtitle_cues(subtitles: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Normalize subtitle cues to a standard structure with start_ms, end_ms, and text.

methods.name: List[str] _tokenize(text: str)
methods.description: Tokenize text on whitespace for language-agnostic splitting.

methods.name: str _normalize_core_for_compare(core: str)
methods.description: Normalize a token (lowercase, Unicode NFKC) for comparison.

methods.name: float _sequence_similarity(a: str, b: str)
methods.description: Compute normalized similarity ratio between two strings using difflib.

methods.name: Tuple[str,float] _best_fuzzy_match(word: str, candidates: List[str])
methods.description: Find the best fuzzy match for a word among candidate strings with a similarity score.

methods.name: bool _synonym_or_same(a: str, b: str)
methods.description: Check if two strings are synonyms or equivalent under normalization and a synonym map.

methods.name: float _token_overlap_ratio(a_tokens: List[str], b_tokens: List[str])
methods.description: Calculate token overlap ratio between two token lists.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str,str] _split_token_core_punct(token: str)
methods.description: Split a token into leading punctuation, core, and trailing punctuation.

methods.name: int _overlap_ms(a_start: int, a_end: int, b_start: int, b_end: int)
methods.description: Calculate inclusive overlap duration between two time ranges.

methods.name: float _jaccard_similarity(tokens_a: List[str], tokens_b: List[str])
methods.description: Calculate Jaccard similarity over normalized token sets.

methods.name: str _apply_case_like(source: str, target_style: str)
methods.description: Apply the casing pattern of a target style to a source string.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _find_best_segment_window_for_cue(cue: Dict[str, Any], segments: List[Dict[str, Any]], window_ms: int = 8000)
methods.description: Identify the best segment window in transcript segments matching a cue based on token similarity and temporal proximity.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _build_corrected_cue_from_segments(span: Tuple[int, int], segments: List[Dict[str, Any]], base_cue_text: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Construct a corrected cue from a span of transcript segments, performing word-level corrections and metadata logging.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _generate_missing_cues(segments: List[Dict[str, Any]], used_spans: List[Tuple[int, int]])
methods.description: Generate cues for uncovered transcript segments.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _enforce_ott_constraints(cues: List[Dict[str, Any]], min_duration_ms: int = 800, max_duration_ms: int = 8000)
methods.description: Clamp and adjust cues to adhere to OTT timing constraints (min/max duration, no overlaps).

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _merge_and_sort_cues(primary: List[Dict[str, Any]], generated: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Combine primary and generated cues, removing duplicates and sorting by start time.

methods.name: str _reindex_and_format_srt(cues: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Convert cues to SRT format with incremental indexing.

methods.name: list correct_subtitles(transcript: dict, subtitles: list)
methods.description: Main function to align, correct, and enforce timing constraints on subtitles based on a transcript.

methods.name: str apply_additional_compliance_fixes(path: str, processed_dir: str)
methods.description: Post-processing hook to apply additional subtitle fixes, currently by copying files.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] char_profile(text: str)
methods.description: unavailable
